screens.title: Avant-Garde — Chronos Orbital Kinetic HUD
aiNotes:
I have crafted the **Chronos // Orbital Kinetic HUD** screen (Chronos // Orbital Kinetic HUD), an avant-garde native Android Compose Canvas telemetry experience adhering to the **Set 3: Chronos Orbital Kinetic HUD** design language.

### Key Architectural & Visual Decisions:

1. **Orca Stage Matrix & Status Header**:
   - High-density monospace status header displaying real-time orchestrator sync status and latency.
   - Three dedicated Orca pipeline stage readiness cards: **Planner** (*Gemini 4 Argon · 55% Active*), **Builder** (*Flash 100% / OpenCode 98% Ready*), and **Reviewer** (*Grok 4.7 Primed Standby*).

2. **Concentric Orbital Chronometer (Compose Canvas Hero)**:
   - Deep obsidian radar surface featuring coordinate reticles (`000°`, `090°`, `180°`, `270°`) and hairline orbital tracks.
   - **Inner Ring**: 5-Hour rolling horizon (100% Flash buffer).
   - **Middle Ring**: 7-Day tactical horizon with an electric phosphor arc tracking Gemini 4 Argon's 55% reserve, complete with the orange pace anchor tick vector at 96.8% elapsed.
   - **Outer Ring**: 30-Day strategic horizon representing OpenCode monthly allocation.
   - Centered oversized tabular readout (`55%`) with real-time pace delta (`-51% UNDER PACE · RESETS 19:39 UTC`).

3. **Hairline Monospace Telemetry Strip**:
   - Zero standard rounded cards; structured with crisp hairline-divided rows (`border-outline-variant`) for maximum data density.
   - Live stream metrics highlighting burn rate (`0.28%/hr` vs `0.59%/hr` cap pace), token TTL, RPM ceilings, and unmetered pipes across Argon, Flash, OpenCode, and Grok.

4. **Tactile Time-Travel Horizon Scrubber**:
   - Interactive projection slider mapping `NOW [0h] → +1h → +4h [SCRUB] → RESET (19:39 UTC)`.
   - Real-time simulation readout computing dynamic quota impact at current burn rate: `53.9% Remaining (-1.1% burn delta, +50.2% headroom)`.
   - Quick action triggers for `INSPECT VECTOR LOG` and `ADJUST THROTTLE MESH`.

screens.title: Avant-Garde — Phase-Space Multi-Stream Velocity Graph
aiNotes:
I have designed and generated the avant-garde native Android **Chronos Orbital Kinetic HUD** telemetry screen (Chronos Orbital Kinetic HUD), adhering strictly to the Chronos design language ([Design_System]).

### Key Architectural & Visual Components:
1. **Asymmetric Tabular Header**:
   - Oversized monospace readout `45.0% USED / 96.8% WINDOW ELAPSED` under the category moniker `PHASE-SPACE VELOCITY // ALL SUBSCRIPTIONS`.
   - Native telemetry readouts featuring Current Burn Rate (`0.28%/HR OPTIMAL`), Projected Reserve (`+51.8% SAFE`), and Phase Drift (`0.00% LOCKED`).
   - Split linear pace indicator with a `+51.8% CRITICAL SURPLUS` margin indicator.

2. **Compose Canvas Multi-Stream Horizon Graph**:
   - 7-day layered horizon stream tracking `agy` (Gemini 4 Argon & Flash, cyan), `opencode` (DeepSeek 4.1, neon green), and `grok` (Grok 4.7, amber).
   - Dynamic vertical telemetry run markers flagging autonomous orchestrations: `Orca #104 (Tree Synth)`, `Orca #108 (Full Pipeline)`, and `Orca #112`.
   - Time-travel scrub controls (`SCRUB T-MINUS: 4h 22m TO UTC RESET`) with delta projection quick-actions (`+1h BURN`, `+4h PROJECTION`, `+24h RESET`).

3. **Grok Token Lifecycle Pulse Module**:
   - High-contrast kinetic countdown gauge tracking the 90-minute Grok OAuth lease lifecycle (`31m 14s remaining · 65.2% depleted`).
   - Hardware security context (`STRONGBOX KEYMASTER: ARMED`) with scheduled keepalive prime status (`SMART PRIME ARMED FOR 16:08 UTC`).
   - Tactile interactive terminal trigger button (`PRIME PULSE [grok -p "reply with ok"]`).

4. **High-Density Monospace Bucket Matrix**:
   - Hairline grid table providing unified telemetry across all 9 tracked allocation buckets:
     * `gemini-argon-wtu-weekly`
     * `gemini-3.8-flash-5h` & `gemini-3.8-flash-weekly`
     * `deepseek-4.1-5h`, `weekly`, and `monthly`
     * `grok-4.7-credits`
     * `claude-gpt-3p-5h` & `claude-gpt-3p-weekly` standby channels.
   - Fixed HUD bottom navigation bar anchored to the `HORIZON` view.

screens.title: Conservative — Primary Quota Dashboard
aiNotes:
I have designed and generated the **AI Quota Monitor** mobile dashboard for Pixel 8 Pro, modeled precisely on Google Pixel Settings and Digital Wellbeing utility patterns.

### Design Highlights:
- **Material 3 Expressive & Tonal Architecture:** Applied the Pixel Tonal Utility palette with `surfaceContainerLow` and high-contrast typography, matching native Pixel 8 Pro system settings.
- **Top App Bar & Segmented Controls:** Features the `"AI Quota Monitor"` header with live Tailscale sync state (`"Synced via Tailscale · 1m ago"`), refresh action, and an M3 Segmented Button switching between **% Remaining** and **% Used**.
- **System Summary Card (Tightest Bucket):** Highlights **Gemini 4 Argon Weekly** at 55% remaining with time-to-reset countdown (`4h 22m remaining`) and a tonal badge indicating burn rate performance (`51% Under Linear Pace`).
- **Antigravity (CLI) Provider Card:** Formatted as structured vertical list cards with linear progress indicators and vertical pace markers:
  - *Gemini 4 Argon (Weekly)*: Tabular 55% remaining with a distinct vertical pace tick marker at the 96% window progression mark.
  - *Gemini 3.8 Flash (5h Rolling & Weekly)*: Full capacity metrics with window resets and operational stages.
- **OpenCode Go & Grok Build Cards:** 
  - OpenCode Go tracking DeepSeek 4.1 across 5h rolling, weekly, and monthly allocations with percentage used breakdown.
  - Grok Build displaying token lease expiration (`16:23 UTC`), 97% weekly credits remaining, and on-demand overage caps.
- **M3 Navigation Bar:** Standard 3-destination Android navigation bar anchored with **Quotas (Active)**, **Pace & History**, and **Relay & Widgets**.

screens.title: Conservative — Provider Detail & Burn History
aiNotes:
I have designed and generated the native Android mobile detail screen for **Antigravity (agy) Quota Detail** in the **Pixel Settings Tonal Utility** design system.

### Key Features & Design Architecture:
1. **Top App Bar & Horizon Filter:**
   - Native Material 3 app bar with back navigation, quick refresh indicator, and overflow actions.
   - Segmented filter pills with **"7 Days"** marked as active alongside **"24 Hours"**, **"30 Days"**, and **"Custom"**.

2. **Primary Bottleneck Pace Summary Card:**
   - Highlights the critical limiter `gemini-argon-wtu-weekly (Gemini 4 Argon)` with a **"Safe Pace (-51.8%)"** status chip.
   - Clear tabular metrics displaying **55% Remaining Quota** (45.0% Used) and reset timing (in 4h 22m).
   - Dual-reference progress track contrasting actual consumption (45%) against elapsed window progress (96.8%).
   - 2×2 metric grid detailing **Elapsed Window (96.8%)**, **Quota Used (45.0%)**, **Pace Delta (-51.8% Safe)**, and **Projected at Reset (52% Reserve)**.

3. **7-Day Stepped Burn vs. Linear Pace Chart:**
   - Custom coordinate graph illustrating the stepped batch usage curve from 100% down to 55% across discrete agent turns (D1–D7).
   - Dashed diagonal baseline representing the **Linear Window Pace** target to visualize the large safe reserve buffer.
   - Live marker pin at D7 indicating current pace (`0.27%/hr`) and window ceiling (`1,000,000 WTU`).

4. **All Buckets Breakdown List:**
   - Covers all 5 active buckets within the provider:
     - `gemini-argon-wtu-weekly` (Gemini 4 Argon, Bottleneck) at **55% Left** (Resets 19:39 UTC)
     - `gemini-5h` (Gemini Models, Dormant) at **100% Left** (Resets 20:04 UTC)
     - `gemini-weekly` (Gemini Models, Full capacity) at **100% Left** (Resets 8 Nov)
     - `3p-5h` (Claude & GPT, Ready) at **100% Left** (Resets 20:04 UTC)
     - `3p-weekly` (Claude & GPT, Unallocated) at **100% Left** (Resets 8 Nov)

5. **Recent Stage Checkpoints Log:**
   - Chronological audit trail showing quota deltas per agent turn (`-2% Argon` on pre-flight, `-8% Argon` on planning turn, and `0% delta` routine sync).
   - Bottom CTA buttons for **Export Metrics** and **Adjust Throttling**, with fixed bottom navigation.

screens.title: Conservative — Glance Widgets & Dual-Transport Settings
aiNotes:
Here is the native Android **Widgets & Sync Transport** screen designed according to the **Pixel Material You Tonal Utility** system:

2. **Jetpack Glance Widget Previews (Pixel 8 Pro Launcher)**:

screens.title: Modern — M3 Expressive Bento Dashboard
aiNotes:
### Flagship Material 3 Expressive Bento Dashboard — Pixel 8 Pro

I have generated the **Quota Pulse** flagship mobile dashboard tailored to Android 16 Material 3 Expressive guidelines (`Quota Pulse - M3 Expressive Bento`), using the **Material 3 Expressive Bento & Arcs** design system (`[Design_System]`).

#### Key Architecture & Highlights:
1. **Expressive Header & Polarity Segment Toggle:**
   - Pixel status bar (9:41, 5G, 94% battery) with brand mark and encrypted live state: `Tailscale Live · Gist Encrypted Backup`.
   - Dual-state polarity toggle pill switching between `% Left (Remaining)` and `% Used (Burned)`.
2. **Hero Bottleneck Bento Card (Full-Width 28dp Squircle):**
   - Spotlights the tightest planning bucket (`Gemini 4 Argon · Weekly`) with `#GA-8942` tracker and `Active Safe Guard` pill badge.
   - Large sweeping Compose Canvas **radial arc gauge** (270° sweep) displaying `55% LEFT` with a glowing pace needle indicating target notch headroom (`Target Notch: 96.8%`).
   - Side telemetry stack featuring reset countdown (`4h 22m`), `-51% Linear` pace delta badge, and a glowing 7-day velocity bezier curve (`0.27%/hr`).
3. **Asymmetric 2-Column Bento Row:**
   - **OpenCode Go (DeepSeek 4.1):** High-density squircle card with radial ring indicator at `98% Weekly`, secondary status pills for 5h rolling (`100%`) and monthly quota (`99%`), and zero-burn state.
   - **Grok Build (Grok 4.7):** Warm amber themed bento card displaying `97% Credits` ($25 Safe), `Smart Primed` keepalive TTL pill badge (`1h 19m`), and overage safety lock.
4. **Antigravity Multi-Bucket Bento Strip:**
   - Grouped fast execution models with high-contrast pill progress tracks: `Gemini 3.8 Flash (5h Rolling)`, `Gemini 3.8 Flash (Weekly)`, and unmetered `Claude & GPT 3P`.
   - Actionable `Inspect CLI Checkpoints & Sync` interaction trigger.
5. **Floating Bottom Pill Toolbar:**

screens.title: Modern — Expressive Burn Velocity & Pace Projection

   - Soft luminous aquamarine/cyan area gradient fill underneath the curve.
   - Dual-reference lines: a diagonal dashed linear benchmark line (`100% Linear Window Pace`) alongside a forward-looking dotted trajectory terminating safely at an interactive waypoint badge: **"52% Reserve at Reset (19:39 UTC)"**.

screens.title: Modern — Expressive Glance Widgets & Relay Hub
aiNotes:

### What Was Designed & Key Elements:
1. **Live Launcher Preview Canvas (Pixel 8 Pro)**:

2. **Dual-Transport Bento Cards**:
   - **Tailscale Direct Node**: Priority 1 WireGuard mesh channel showing `14ms` latency, active status toggle, and direct HTTP zero-proxy push indicators.
   - **GitHub Gist Encrypted Relay**: Standby roaming fallback with verified `AES-256-GCM` badge, hardware-backed Android Keystore enclave verification, and on-demand `Test Decrypt` / `Force Push` controls.
